title: Best robot lawn mower deal: Save over $500 on the Ecovacs Goat O1000 robot mower
excerpt: If you're tired of cutting the grass, this robot can assist without costing an entire month's rent.
content_html:
SAVE $550.94: As of Oct. 13, get the Ecovacs Goat O1000 robot lawn mower for $949.05 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $1,499.99. That's a discount of 37%.

Credit: Amazon

$949.05 at Amazon
$1,499.99 Save $550.94

The leaves may be changing and cooler temperatures rolling in, but that doesn't mean your responsibilities to your lawn have suddenly vanished. If you want to keep things tidy, you'll still have to mow the lawn occasionally. But if you don't mind shelling out a little cash upfront, you can hire a robot to handle all of that work for you without complaint. That's thanks to this excellent deal courtesy of Amazon on a great robot lawn mower.

As of Oct. 13, get the Ecovacs Goat O1000 robot lawn mower for $949.05 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $1,499.99. That's $550.94 off and a discount of 37%.

This wire-free robot lawn mower is all about making it easy for you to have a freshly-manicured lawn. It uses its HoloScope 360-degree Dual-LiDAR system to create a map of your yard before tackling each job.

Using this system, it can avoid all of the issues that might normally plague a robot handling human business: flower beds, sidewalks, driveways, and other areas. That leaves it freed up to trim away along edges and paths that you set or it analyzes on its own for down to 2cm positioning.

You can let it run on its own and map out your lawn by identifying over 200 types of obstacles, or you can use the accompanying app and set up mowing zones, schedules, and customizable no-go areas that the robot will completely avoid. It's all down to what you find more convenient, and the ability to set and forget lawn care feels pretty convenient to us.

Be sure to grab this robot lawn mower while it's still on sale for a limited time at Amazon.
